shape.description: Analytic 2D SDF shape: circle or rounded box. Switching recompiles the effect variant.

scale.description: Uniform shape scale in the rotated field space.

rotation.description: Rigid in-plane rotation of the field; zero is identity.

depth.description: Signed relief depth; negative is inset (debossed), positive is raised (embossed). Zero is an exact child passthrough including alpha.

lightAngle.description: Directional light azimuth for edge lighting and the cast-shadow trace; the z component stays fixed at 0.7.

lightIntensity.description: Strength of directional edge highlights and shadows; zero removes edge lighting entirely.

shadowIntensity.description: Darkness of the relief cast shadow; zero removes the shadow layer.

sourceKind.description: Deterministic child source pattern; blank renders a fully transparent child (alpha-0 NaN guard).
